name: Layout
description: Page-level vertical layout with design-system spacing, responsive horizontal padding and themed background.

semantics.nativeAttributes: Forward the target stack's native div attributes and events.
semantics.content: Render children as the page or section content.

accessibility: Keep the default div semantics unless the target application requires a specific page or section landmark.
Preserve the accessible semantics of all child content.
Forward native attributes and custom classes according to the target framework.
adaptationRules: Implement Layout as a reusable component in the target application's framework.
Preserve the 280px minimum width and responsive padding behavior where the client layout permits it.
Use the target framework's native children or slot/content convention.
Use the complete design token CSS artifact when the client has no equivalent token system.
Do not install Preact, Sass or any other dependency solely for this component.
